In [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] used a '''vehicle shed''' to hide his [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] on [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]].<ref name="Missed">{{JournalCite|7|Missed Chance}}, p. 53</ref> The vehicle shed was located in the outskirts of [[Pesktda]],<ref name="Missed Chance">{{JournalCite|7|Missed Chance}}, p. 82</ref> and had [[djorra]] [[Vine/Legends|vines]] growing across its front.<ref name="Missed" />
